label: Root links from Thomas Aquinas, In octo libros Physicorum Aristotelis expositio
summary: VII, lect. 1 nn. 886-889: whatever is moved is moved by some other: Aquinas's commentary argues that a divisible mobile whose whole motion depends on motion of the parts cannot move itself primarily and per se. The case needs a bridge from that analysis to each indexed respect of the routed movement, including which intrinsic mover counts as distinct from what moves in that respect.
